DuplicateCase.Title: Verify System Response to No Product Detected by Sensor D2
DuplicateCase.Description: Validate that the system correctly identifies a NONE product type when sensor D2 does not detect any product, ensuring the gripper remains open and appropriate status is logged.
DuplicateCase.Objective: Ensure correct identification of NONE product type when sensor D2 fails to detect an object
DuplicateCase.Comments: Precondition: Sensor D2 must be simulated as inactive or returning no detection signal
